cd /var/home/bmosher/pilot-gen45-work/run_23 && python3 -c "
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP, ROUND_HALF_DOWN, ROUND_05UP
# Test: -1.005 should round to -1.01 (away from zero)
# Test: 1.005 should round to 1.01 (away from zero)
d = Decimal('-1.005')
print('ROUND_HALF_UP:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('ROUND_HALF_DOWN:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_DOWN))
print('ROUND_05UP:', d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_05UP))

d2 = Decimal('1.005')
print('ROUND_HALF_UP:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('ROUND_05UP:', d2.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_05UP))
"
